experiment_data.hypothesis: r=0.2 with seed 44 reproduces Type II trajectory (transient dip + recovery) observed in exp_007 (seed42) and exp_017 (seed43). Third seed enables 3-seed coverage for r=0.2, resolving whether D-4 V-shaped recovery (seed42) is a 1/3 outlier or a majority pattern. Strengthens C3 signal attenuation claim and R1-N2 seed replication.
